y9-11d-q12b.question: Rewrite the equation \(8x + 2y = 6\) in the form \(y = mx + c\) and write down the gradient and \(y\)-intercept. Format: y = [eq], m = [val], c = [val]
y9-11d-q12b.title: Rewrite the equation 8x + 2y = 6 in the ...
y9-11d-q12b.solution:
Rearrange the equation to isolate \(y\):
\(8x + 2y = 6\) becomes \(y = -4x + 3\).

From this form:
- Gradient \(m = -4\)
- \(y\)-intercept \(c = 3\).
